about: The EEVEE settings Renderbricker's EEVEE button sets (rbcore/engine.py, eevee_best): everything EEVEE can do. One table, read by the add-on itself and by the importers' build, so both set the same (UPDATES #38). Only the settings a Blender version has are set. The setup scene (setup/renderbricks_setup.blend) keeps Blender's plain EEVEE values; this table is what overrides them.
